test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter-series.

G _ A R E G L _ R _ G _ C _ E G L _ _ E

options.text: K B E L R D R
L B E L R D R
L A E L R E R
K B E L R E R

solution:
Given :- G _ A R E G L _ R _ G _ C _ E G L _ _ E

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) K B E L R D R → G **K** A R E - G L **B** R **E** - G **L** C **R** E - G L **D R **E

2) L B E L R D R → G **L** A R E - G L **B** R **E** - G **L** C **R** E - G L **D R **E

 
• Here 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/274af50c9894976e37ad94c44d69146255c76946b612d2b4b2be6fad38fd05cf.png] 
 
• is repeated

3) L A E L R E R → G **L** A R E - G L **A** R **E** - G **L** C **R** E - G L **E R** E

4) K B E L R E R → G **K** A R E - G L **B** R **E** - G **L** C **R** E - G L **E R** E

 
• Option (2) gives the pattern of :- G L A R E - G L B R E - G L C R E - G L D R E

Hence, the correct answer is **"L B E L R D R".**
